mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id_flight, id_user, id_channel, code, cabin_class, total_price, total_tax, pay_status, order_status, pay_time, issue_time, cancel_time, remark) VALUES (#{idFlight}, #{idUser}, #{idChannel}, #{code}, #{cabinClass}, #{totalPrice}, #{totalTax}, #{payStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{payTime}, #{issueTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET id_flight = #{idFlight}, id_user = #{idUser}, id_channel = #{idChannel}, code = #{code}, cabin_class = #{cabinClass}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, total_tax = #{totalTax}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, issue_time = #{issueTime}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
